note: Guideline recommendations for medication, each with the guideline's own words. The Chinese original of the 2023 lipid guideline has no open full text; the English versions published by the same committee (Front Pharmacol, CC BY 4.0; J Geriatr Cardiol, free on PMC) are quoted verbatim, so text_zh and dose_text_zh are in English. Table cells joined with ' | ' as extracted from the PMC full text. CPIC results are not here: clinical rx reads them from work/pgx/pgx.json.

ldl.units_note: mg/dL factor is the cholesterol factor already used for HDL-C in data/organs.json

rules.text_zh: 2. Moderate-intensity statins as initiation therapy for achieving lipid-lowering target
rules.dose_text_zh: Moderate intensity (25%–50% reduction in LDL-C at daily dose) | Atorvastatin 10–20 mg | Rosuvastatin 5–10 mg | Fluvastatin 80 mg | Lovastatin 40 mg | Pitavastatin 1∼4 mg | Pravastatin 40 mg | Simvastatin 20–40 mg | XZK 1.2 g
rules.note_zh: 低密度脂蛋白胆固醇达到 4.9 mmol/L 及以上，按指南直接归为高危；生活方式干预是降脂治疗的基础。是否用药由医生决定。

source.title: 2023 Chinese guideline for lipid management (Li JJ, Zhao SP, et al.; Joint Committee on the 2023 Chinese guideline for lipid management). Front Pharmacol 2023;14:1190934 (CC BY 4.0)
source.quote: Among those without ASCVD, those who meet one of the following 3 conditions are directly classified as high-risk and do not require additional 10-year risk assessment for ASCVD: 1) LDL-C ≥ 4.9 mmol/L (or TC ≥ 7.2 mmol/L); 2) diabetic patients aged ≥40 years; or 3) CKD stage 3–5.
source.locator: Section 5 Overall risk assessment for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease
